sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Partisan is a Boss in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: In Afghanistan, Partisan spent long months on solo mountain raids. Through traps and ambushes, he took out over a dozen enemy field commanders who no one else could ever reach.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Partisan's footsteps have reduced volume.
- Partisan does not set off tripwires, both his own and player-placed.
- Killing Partisan as a Scav does not carry any penalties towards your Scav karma.
- Partisan has different health values than PMCs and Scavs.
| Stats |
| Head: 80; Thorax: 220; Stomach: 190; Arms: 110 each; Legs: 120 each; Total: 950 |
- Instead of the typical 4 single slot pockets, he has 3x (2x3 slot) and 2x (1x3 slot) pockets, bringing their total space to 24 slots.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text: Partisan prefers a stealthy approach, taking advantage of the terrain, setting traps in advance, and only then engaging in open combat. The process of preparing and exploring a location takes up most of his time, while open confrontations are less frequent. When fighting against multiple opponents, he can lure one of the players to his booby-traps which he sets up beforehand. He installs tripwires, actively uses grenades, can move quietly through the terrain and track his target for a long time across the whole location. In the PvP game mode he is more likely to appear in raids with low karma PMCs and will hunt them down. If there are Scavs with low karma (not Scav karma) appearing in a raid he is in, they will also become his targets.
